mid.text: Tovolar was once Arlinn Kord's mentor, but they fell out when she refused to join in slaughtering foresters, and she challenged him for command of the howlpack, wounded him and fled.
Two years after the Travails, he builds a growing pack of dire werewolves and plans to unify all howlpacks under his rule, and his howlpack grows bolder, smarter and stronger.
When Arlinn brings the Moonsilver Key to the Celestus, Tovolar attacks the Harvesttide festival, and his howl compels even Arlinn's own pack to betray her.
Arlinn feigns surrender and then severely wounds him, and Tovolar retreats with the pack.

vow.text: Tovolar's rough, deep howl interrupts Arlinn again, and she finds him surrounded by huge wolves of a new pack, who tell her he is preparing to take the nights as well as the woods.
She cannot accept that wolves can do whatever they want, and he scorns her for having too much church in her, but he invites her to come find him when she is ready for the new world.

At Harvesttide his wolves shatter the festival's barrier, and when Arlinn demands that he call off the raid, he refuses and they fight, until she drives her claws into his sternum and he agrees to call off the attack.
Later, Tovolar and dozens of wolves arrive to help against Olivia, who drops the Moonsilver Key and flees, though his howlpack has scattered.
